content: OSS Talos UI landscape (GitHub API verified 2026-08-27): siderolabs/theila — the ONLY official OSS Talos web UI — is ARCHIVED since 2022-05-27, 47 stars, superseded by proprietary/BUSL Omni (1358 stars). No actively maintained open-source WEB UI for Talos exists. Closest: Handfish/talos-pilot (Rust TUI, MIT, 243 stars, active) covers node monitoring, log streaming, etcd health, processes, network/pcap, disks, PKI expiry, drain/reboot/rolling ops, bootstrap wizard, config gen (talosconfig/controlplane/worker), apply-config, cluster bootstrap — but is terminal-only, ephemeral (no persistent inventory), no Image Factory, no Talos/K8s upgrades, no versioned patch library/diff. Other tools are CLI/GitOps config generators (talhelper ARCHIVED 694*, aenix-io/talm 484*, TOPF) or in-cluster controllers (tuppr 298* AGPL, talos-operator 72*) which die with the cluster. Gap for an out-of-cluster web UI is real.
